name: Tablet Experience
author: maxt
description: Laptop/Tablet mode for detachable 2-in-1s: no auto-rotate on tablet entry (sensor-following auto + explicit fixed angles only), virtual-keyboard toggle (SUPER+U / bar button / 3-finger tap), top-bar show/hide toggle (tablet only), input-method quick switch (EN/中, tablet only), voice input (voxtype hold-to-talk bottom button, tablet only), keyboard auto mode-switch, laptop-mode display reset, tablet simplified bar (essentials + ⋮ overflow with per-icon on/off toggles and Hide/Show all), and a tablet window-manage popup.

barWidget.displayName: Tablet mode + keyboard + IME + voice + window
barWidget.description: Laptop/Tablet toggle + rotation + tablet window manage (close/move) + virtual-keyboard show/hide + input-method quick switch + voxtype voice input (all tablet only)
